units.source_text: 但我猜想，有为子起初很害怕，后来发现我之后，就只顾望着我的嘴。

en.t: But I imagine that at first Uiko was very frightened, and after she noticed me, she cared only about staring at my mouth.

units.source_text: 大概是在黎明前的黑暗中，她只望见一个微不足道的小黑洞——

en.t: Perhaps in the darkness before dawn, all she saw was one insignificant little black hole,

units.source_text: 野生小动物巢穴似的肮脏而不漂亮的小洞，在毫无意义地张动着。

en.t: a dirty, ugly little hole like the den of a small wild animal, opening and closing without any meaning.

units.source_text: 也就是说，她只望见我的嘴。

en.t: In other words, she saw only my mouth.

units.source_text: 在确认从这小洞里不会产生任何一种可与外界联系的力量之后，她才放下心来。

en.t: Only after making sure that no power capable of connecting with the outside world would come from that little hole did she feel relieved.

units.source_text: 像躲开了石头似的避开了我，迂回地驶了过去。

en.t: She avoided me as though avoiding a stone, made a detour, and went past.

units.source_text: 有为子远去了，我不时听见在间无人影的田野的远方传来了几下像是嘲笑似的铃声。

en.t: Uiko went farther away, and from time to time I heard several bell sounds, like mockery, coming from far across the deserted fields.
